title: Provisions of parts III to XIV refer to vehicles upon the highways; exceptions.
partHeading: PART III. OBEDIENCE TO AND EFFECT OF TRAFFIC LAWS
bodyText:
RULES OF THE ROAD

The provisions of parts III to XIV relating to the operation of vehicles refer exclusively to the operation of vehicles upon highways except, where a different place is specifically referred to in a given section.
bodyHtml:
RULES OF THE ROAD

 

PART III.  OBEDIENCE TO AND EFFECT OF TRAFFIC LAWS

 

     [§291C-21]  Provisions of parts III to XIV refer to vehicles upon the highways; exceptions.  The provisions of parts III to XIV relating to the operation of vehicles refer exclusively to the operation of vehicles upon highways except, where a different place is specifically referred to in a given section. [L 1971, c 150, pt of §1]
